notice: Authored study notes, invented learner/timetable records, and prepared provider responses; no model generated these fixtures.

sources.text: The learner wants an introductory note about how models learn, with a study-time estimate of at most 30 minutes.

N01, Overfitting: introductory, learning topic, estimated 20 minutes. A model can fit training examples too closely and perform poorly on new cases. N05, Embeddings: advanced, search topic, estimated 45 minutes.
No exam date is supplied for the topic covered by N01, Overfitting.

cases.label: Invalid credentials
cases.lesson: A prepared 401 is not retried. Repeating unchanged credentials cannot fix configuration.

cases.label: Refused response
cases.lesson: Refusal content is a distinct outcome, not a recommendation to parse or a reason to bypass the refusal.

cases.label: Incomplete response
cases.lesson: A partial answer must not become a finished recommendation. Stop and inspect the cause before changing the output budget.

cases.label: Broken JSON
cases.lesson: The parser rejects the prepared malformed text; repeating a network call is not the same as repairing content.

cases.label: Wrong field type
cases.lesson: Valid JSON still fails the recommendation contract when an exam date is a number.
